jobs.title: Senior Change and Release Manager
jobs.description:
**About Ensono**


Ensono is an expert technology adviser and managed service provider. As a relentless ally, we accelerate clients’ digital transformation to achieve business outcomes that stand to last. Our dedicated team helps organizations optimize today’s systems across any hybrid environment with services such as consulting, mainframe and application modernization, public cloud migration and cloud\-native development. With certified experts in AWS, Azure and Google Cloud and recognized as Microsoft Datacenter Transformation Partner of the Year, Ensono has over 4500\+ associates globally and is headquartered in greater Chicago.


We care about your success, offering comprehensive strategic and managed services for mission\-critical applications. Our Advisory and Consulting services can help upfront with an application strategy or find the right places for your applications – whether it’s public, multi or hybrid cloud, or mainframe. And because we span across all mission\-critical platforms, we can meet you wherever you are in your digital transformation journey, with 24/7 support when you need it. We are your relentless ally, flexing with you when challenges emerge so you don’t feel stuck in place. With cross\-platform certifications and decades of experience, our technology experts have become an extension of your team so you’re continuously innovating – doing more with less while remaining secure. And that’s just the beginning**.**

At Ensono, we re\-imagine the way we work, the way we connect with each other – our colleagues, clients and partners – and the way we deliver value. Being agile will make us more responsive, more adaptable, and ultimately more innovative.


We’re looking for a Release Manager/Infrastructure Engineer to:


* Globally run the zOS, AIX and AS400 operating system platform release and test management
* Act as central point to plan platform software change requests, creating related roadmaps and timelines
* Provide \& maintain packaging environment and software inventory for other teams
* Execute the test planning and coordination with Engineering teams (test plans, test orders, sign off conference calls, test reports)
* Work within change management methodology and procedures to deliver a final stable product to operations
* Coordinate deployment of fixes and Single Distributions for platform products
* Ensure compliance and audibility for software components according to internal SDLC/QAP/MER/ICC processes
* Provide continual improvement to platform release and test management processes
* ensure the quality, security, reliability, and compliance of solutions by applying our digital principles and implementing both functional and non\-functional requirements
* build observability into our solutions, monitor production health, help to resolve incidents, and remediate the root cause of risks and issues.
* learn new technologies and practices, reuse strategic platforms and standards, evaluate options, and make decisions with long\-term sustainability in mind

**Your team**


In our agile operating model, crews are aligned to larger products and services fulfilling client needs and encompass multiple autonomous pods. You’ll be working in the Mainframe as a Service team in Hyderabad focusing to continuously improve our processes to gain higher efficiency, sustainability and reliability.


**Your expertise**


* IT basic knowledge, a minimum of 10 years’ experience in IT services
* Basic system knowhow (IBM zOS mainframe, AIX or AS400\) appreciated, but no must
* ITIL knowledge (specifically Release\-, Test\- and Change\-Management) appreciated, no must
* Change management knowledge
* Test Management knowledge
* Personal skills: teamwork, initiative, efficiency, friendliness, ability to work under pressure, carefulness precision
* Customer focus: secure, mature and pleasant appearance, good manners, networking skills (social)
* Strong communication skills in English

**Shift Timings:** 1:30 PM IST to 10:30 PM IST


5 days work from office


We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to caste, colour, creed, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, HIV status, or any other status protected by law. Candidates with disabilities who require accommodations during the recruitment process are encouraged to contact our Talent Acquisition team to place a request.

jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math, a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience in software development.
* 6 years of experience in full\-stack software development and system design.
* 2 years of experience as a tech lead or engineering manager.
* Experience with back\-end languages (e.g., Java, Python, or C\+\+).
* Experience with front\-end languages (e.g., JavaScript or TypeScript).
* Experience working with database technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 2 years of experience designing scalable microservice or cloud system architectures.
* 2 years of experience with site reliability engineering, information security, or DevOps practices.

**About the job**
-----------------


gTech Ads is responsible for all support and media and technical services for customers big and small across our entire Ad products stack. We help our customers get the most out of our Ad and Publisher products and guide them when they need help. We provide a range of services from enabling better self help and in\-product support, to providing better support through interactions, setting up accounts and implementing ad campaigns, and providing media solutions for customers business and marketing needs and providing complex technical and measurement solutions along with consultative support for our large customers. These solutions range from bespoke and customized ones for our customers to scalable support for millions of customers worldwide. Based on the evolving needs of our ads customers, we partner with Sales, Product and Engineering teams within Google to develop better solutions, tools, and services to improve our products and enhance our client experience. As a cross\-functional and global team, we ensure our customers get the best return on investment with Google and we remain a trusted partner.

  


The Tools, Automation and Infrastructure (TAI) Engineering teams function as a pivotal unit within TAI, dedicated to supporting the future for gTech Ads. The team works to deliver scalable, globally applicable solutions and platforms.


Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.  

  

To learn more about gTech, check out our video.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Set and communicate individual and team priorities that support organizational goals. Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance and development, and provide feedback and coaching.
* Drive feature changes using data\-driven insights by analyzing data sets on users behaviors to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Optimize front\-end code and tools to meet user needs by working with engineers to refine code and tools, and ensuring that they are correct and appropriate for user needs.
* Identify, recommend, and prioritize new web features and applications by working with business leaders and product managers to understand user needs, and develop plans for new features and applications.
* Work with cross\-team stakeholders to understand the user experience by conducting user research, and working with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure that the user experience is optimized.

jobs.description:
**Join Us as Manager, DevOps!**
We are seeking an experienced DevOps Manager to lead our DevOps and cloud infrastructure function. In this role, you will build and develop a high\-performing team while driving automation, operational excellence, and modern engineering practices. You will play a critical role in ensuring our applications and infrastructure remain secure, scalable, reliable, and highly available, enabling the business to deliver technology solutions efficiently and confidently. **Why You’ll Love Working Here**
As DevOps Manager, you will lead the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of our DevOps and cloud infrastructure capabilities. You will partner closely with Software Engineering, Security, Architecture, and Product teams to enhance delivery performance, system reliability, and operational efficiency. This role offers the opportunity to influence engineering standards, modernize infrastructure practices, and develop a culture focused on ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.  

This position will be based in our Hyderabad office, working onsite. **What You’ll Do****Lead and** **Develop** **the DevOps Function*** Lead, mentor, and develop a team of DevOps, cloud, and infrastructure engineers.
* Establish team goals, performance expectations, and measurable outcomes.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Support employee growth through coaching, mentoring, career development, and regular feedback.

**Drive DevOps Strategy and Engineering Excellence*** Define and execute the organization's DevOps strategy, roadmap, and engineering standards.
* Drive adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, and configuration management practices.
* Evaluate and recommend tools, technologies, and platforms that improve engineering productivity and operational reliability.
* Balance technical debt, operational risk, business priorities, and engineering capacity.

**Build and Operate Secure, Scalable Infrastructure*** Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, highly available cloud infrastructure.
* Establish best practices for cloud operations, system reliability, observability, performance, and availability.
* Participate in capacity planning, disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
* Manage cloud infrastructure costs and identify opportunities for optimization.

**Improve Delivery, Reliability, and Operational Performance*** Own and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
* Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident management capabilities.
* Lead root\-cause analysis activities and ensure corrective and preventative actions are completed following major incidents.
* Establish and track operational metrics including deployment frequency, lead time, availability, reliability, and recovery time.

**Partner Across the Organization*** Collaborate with Engineering, Security, Architecture, and Product teams to improve software delivery and operational efficiency.
* Promote DevSecOps practices, including security controls, vulnerability management, access management, and compliance requirements.
* Develop documentation, standards, runbooks, and operational procedures.
* Manage relationships with technology vendors and service providers as needed.
* Communicate technical risks, opportunities, and recommendations to both technical and executive stakeholders.

 **Who You Are**
You are a hands\-on technology leader who combines deep technical expertise with a passion for building high\-performing teams. You have experience implementing modern DevOps practices and creating scalable, reliable cloud environments while enabling engineering teams to deliver at speed and with quality.
If you have:* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7\+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), systems engineering, or related disciplines.
* 3\+ years of experience leading or managing technical teams.
* Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform, including AWS, Azure, or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tools, pipelines, and deployment practices.
* Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar platforms.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
* Strong understanding of Windows, Linux, networking, databases, and distributed systems.
* Experience with observability, monitoring, logging, and incident response practices.
* Working knowledge of security principles and DevSecOps methodologies.
* Strong understanding of Git and modern software development workflows.
* Excellent communication, leadership, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.

**Preferred:*** Experience building or scaling DevOps or SRE organizations.
* Experience supporting multi\-cloud or hybrid\-cloud environments.
* Experience implementing Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and reliability engineering principles.
* Experience with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, or similar tools.
* Experience with scripting or programming languages such as Python, Bash, or Go.

 Wise is building money without borders. Our customers should be able to move, hold, receive, and spend money internationally with a product that is fast, transparent, low\-cost, and safe.
   

  

 Verification is central to that mission. We need to keep financial crime out of Wise, meet regulatory obligations across many markets, and make it easy for legitimate customers to get started and use our products.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Global KYC and Onboarding Squad is improving Wise's KYC and onboarding experience by reducing three things at the same time:
   

  

* Financial crime risk, by making reviews, controls, and decisioning more effective.
* Operational cost, by automating repeatable work and improving how agents handle complex cases.
* Customer friction, by making verification clearer, faster, and easier to complete.


 Business Onboarding Verification focuses on business customers. Businesses are not simple identity objects: they are legal entities connected to directors, shareholders, UBOs, authorised signatories, employees, documents, registry data, vendor data, ownership structures, risk signals, and market\-specific requirements.
   

  

 That makes KYB one of Wise's most complex verification domains. It is also one of the biggest opportunities to improve customer experience, reduce manual work, improve control quality, and build better risk decisioning.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are hiring a Product Manager to own one of the workstreams within Business Onboarding Verification. Each PM within the team owns a complex product area end to end, from discovery and roadmap through delivery, measurement, and iteration.
   

  

 These are not generic AI, programme management, or stakeholder coordination roles. You will coordinate complex work, but the core of the job is product ownership: defining the problem, shaping the solution, making trade\-offs explicit, setting success metrics, launching safely, and ensuring each change improves KYB as a product.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* Own the product roadmap for one BOV workstream, from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Identify the highest\-value problems using customer friction, operational cost, manual review load, risk impact, regulatory need, and delivery readiness.
* Translate ambiguous KYB problems into clear product requirements, launch criteria, success metrics, and learning loops.
* Partner with Engineering, Analytics/Data Science, Product Compliance, Risk, Operations, regional teams, vendors, support partners, and adjacent PMs.
* Define launch metrics and guardrails across customer impact, manual review load, operational adoption, control quality, false positives, false negatives, auditability, monitoring, and rollback.
* Build feedback loops from agents, QA, assurance, customer outcomes, support contacts, downstream risk signals, and vendor/model performance where relevant.
* Balance tactical delivery with long\-term product foundations.


**What Success Looks Like In The First 6\-12 Months**
* Your workstream has a clear roadmap with explicit priorities and measurable outcomes.
* The team has shipped meaningful product improvements, not just analysis or coordination.
* Product changes are safer to launch because metrics, guardrails, monitoring, fallback paths, and ownership are clear.
* Cross\-functional partners understand what is being solved, why it matters, who owns what, and how success will be measured.
* KYB becomes faster, more measurable, more auditable, and easier for legitimate businesses and agents to navigate.


**This Role Gives You The Opportunity To**
* Work on one of the most important regulated onboarding domains at Wise.
* Improve the experience for business customers and the agents reviewing their cases.
* Build practical AI, automation, decisioning, controls, and platform foundations in a real operational environment.
* Work across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Analytics, regional teams, and vendors on high\-stakes problems.
* Shape how Wise moves from fragmented manual review and tactical control work toward reusable, measurable KYB capabilities.


**Qualifications**
**What We Are Looking For**
* You have product management experience owning complex work from discovery through delivery and measurable outcomes.
* You are comfortable in data\-heavy, risk\-sensitive, operational, regulated, onboarding, payments, trust and safety, compliance, or fintech domains.
* You can reason with data and metrics, including denominators, baselines, segmentation, sample bias, data quality, attribution limits, and guardrails.
* You can translate ambiguous product, risk, compliance, or operational problems into clear requirements, launch criteria, and iteration plans.
* You understand that regulated product delivery needs evidence, auditability, operational readiness, monitoring, and ownership.
* You communicate clearly, make trade\-offs explicit, and can create alignment without formal authority.


**Strong Additional Signals**
* Experience in KYB, KYC, business onboarding, financial crime, identity, fraud, risk decisioning, compliance tooling, operational tooling, payments, or regulated fintech.
* Experience with AI, LLMs, ML models, document intelligence, decisioning systems, vendor evaluation, or agent\-assist tooling.

jobs.description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.
   

  

 The Senior Product Manager is one of the key roles in shaping the company’s digital transformation as it evolves from a hardware\-driven to a software\-led organization.
   

  

 The position holds global responsibility for development of WSA’s consumer hearing aid mobile application, which represents the primary interface between the company and hearing aid wearers.
   

  

 This role ensures that the mobile app drives measurable consumer engagement, supports commercial growth, and strengthens brand positioning through digital innovation and data\-driven decision\-making.
   

  

 The incumbent operates with a high degree of autonomy, guiding cross\-functional team and influencing business direction across global markets.
   

  

 In addition to commercial ownership, the role includes direct leadership of a small, international product team operating across India and Europe. The successful candidate will foster collaboration across diverse cultural and functional contexts, bridging engineering execution in India with strategic and commercial leadership in Europe. Serve as a cultural connector, promoting effective collaboration between Western and Indian business environments.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

**Product Leadership**
* Define and execute the long\-term vision and strategy for the consumer application in the WSA ecosystem, aligned with corporate digital transformation goals.
* Translate market dynamics, user insights, and technological trends into a differentiated app strategy and product roadmap.
* Provide product leadership across functions, balancing innovation, commercial priorities, and feasibility.


**Commercial and Analytical Ownership**
* Drive the commercial evaluation of digital initiatives, including business case development, ROI assessment, and financial forecasting.
* Ensure that app initiatives are supported by robust performance metrics and consumer feedback loops.
* Leverage and steer consumer data and analytics to shape feature priorities, drive retention, and optimize lifetime user value.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Act as the primary interface between business, engineering, and market teams, translating strategic intent into deliverable software solutions.
* Collaborate closely with R\&D and software engineering teams, particularly with Indian development partners, ensuring effective global collaboration and delivery alignment.
* Partner with marketing, UX, and commercial teams to ensure end\-to\-end product excellence and regulatory compliance.


**Global Scope and Influence**
 Represent the voice of the global consumer across markets, ensuring the product experience resonates across cultures, languages, and regulatory environments.
   

  

 What you bring
   

  

**Education \& Professional Background**
* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 8\+ years of progressive experience in product management, ideally in digital health, consumer tech, or connected device industries.
* Strong understanding of software engineering processes, agile methodologies, and lifecycle management from a commercial standpoint.


**Technical \& Functional Expertise**
* Proven experience managing data\-driven consumer applications.
* Strong analytical mindset, with ability to synthesize market data, user analytics, and financial insights.
* Expertise in commercial planning and business case development for digital products.


**Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in a matrixed global organization.
* Experience working with or leading teams in India or collaborating with Indian software partners.
* Multilingual proficiency and experience working across multiple cultures preferred.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Strategic and conceptual thinker with strong execution drive.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* High integrity, cultural awareness, and adaptability in a global context.
* Passion for improving the end\-user experience through digital innovation, whether in app or through use of app data.


 Who we are
   

  

 At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.
   

  

 Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.
   

  

 With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.
   

  

 Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.
   

  

*WSA is an equal\-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.*

jobs.description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-253824 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Sep. 23, 2026 CATEGORY: Engineering
The Specialist Scrum Master serves as a servant leader and Agile coach for one or more Scrum teams. This role is responsible for enabling high\-performing teams through effective facilitation, coaching, impediment removal, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence. The Specialist Scrum Master partners closely with Product Owners, Engineering Leads, Architects, and business stakeholders to maximise value delivery and accelerate Agile maturity.### **Key Responsibilities**


Agile Leadership \& Coaching

* Coach teams on Scrum principles, Agile practices, and servant leadership.
* Foster self\-organisation, accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.
* Help teams mature in Agile delivery practices and product thinking.
* Facilitate conflict resolution and promote psychological safety.


Scrum Facilitation

* Facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, Refinements, and Retrospectives.
* Ensure ceremonies remain outcome\-driven and focused on value delivery.
* Drive effective backlog refinement and sprint goal alignment.


Impediment Management

* Identify, track, and facilitate removal of team and organisational blockers.
* Escalate risks and dependencies when necessary.
* Enable teams to proactively address impediments rather than creating dependency on the Scrum Master.


Delivery Excellence

* Monitor Sprint health, team velocity, predictability, and flow metrics.
* Support forecasting, release planning, and delivery commitments.
* Drive adoption of Agile metrics to improve performance and predictability


Stakeholder Collaboration

* Partner with Product Owners to maintain a healthy, prioritised backlog.
* Collaborate with leadership and stakeholders to align delivery objectives.
* Communicate progress, risks, and dependencies transparently.


Continuous Improvement

* Lead meaningful retrospectives resulting in actionable improvements.
* Drive process optimisation initiatives across teams.
* Promote Lean and Agile best practices throughout the organisation

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in Agile environments.
* 3\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master supporting software delivery teams.
* Deep understanding of Scrum, Kanban, Lean, and Agile methodologies.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent Agile tools.
* Strong facilitation, coaching, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), or equivalent certification.
* Experience supporting multiple Scrum teams.
* Experience in scaled Agile environments (SAFe, LeSS, Nexus).
* Knowledge of Agile metrics, flow efficiency, and Lean product delivery

### **Success Measures**

* Improved sprint predictability and delivery reliability.
* Reduced delivery impediments and cycle time.
* Increased team engagement and Agile maturity.
* High stakeholder satisfaction.
* Continuous improvement actions implemented and sustained

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
**About the Role:** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced and technically adept Product Owner (TPO) to join our expanding Product Management team. This is a critical role in the agile delivery of complex, enterprise\-grade compliance solutions. You will act as the bridge between business, design, and engineering \- owning the product backlog and driving the delivery of features that align with business outcomes and user needs. You will be involved in everything from requirements gathering and story writing to solution design and customer documentation.
 



  





**Job requirements:** 




  




* 8\-12 years of experience in Product Management or Product Owner roles in large global, multinational SaaS or enterprise environments.
* Proven success delivering products built on Java, data\-driven architectures, and APIs.
* Experience delivering or supporting AI/ML\-powered features, such as intelligent alerts, predictive analytics, or NLP\-driven workflows.
* Strong understanding of AI\-enhanced user experiences, and ability to write product requirements that align AI capabilities with business value.
* Demonstrated success working in product\-driven SaaS environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills across technical and business audiences.
* Proficient in writing clear, testable user stories, functional and non\-functional requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Skilled in wireframing, data modeling (ERDs), SQL, and API integration.
* Strong problem\-solving ability with attention to detail and a proactive mindset.
* Effective in both independent work and cross\-functional collaboration within fast\-paced, agile environments.
* Proficient in Agile methodologies and project management practices.
* Hands\-on experience with JIRA, Confluence, or similar tools for backlog and documentation management.
* Strong analytical skills for feature validation, requirement refinement, and product performance assessment.
* Deep client insight and ability to align user needs with business goals.
* Experienced in collaborating with Architects/Tech Leads to design scalable solutions and challenge assumptions constructively.
* Skilled in negotiating trade\-offs between scope, resources, and impact to align with product roadmaps.
* Contributes to strategic planning and long\-term roadmap development.
* Adaptable and comfortable working in fast\-paced, evolving environments.
* Able to operate in globally distributed teams across time zones and cultural contexts.
* UX sensibility and ability to partner with designers to shape intuitive user journeys and product experiences.
* Disciplined in backlog grooming, release planning, and sprint execution with agile teams.
* Awareness of change management practices and ability to support internal enablement and customer adoption.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Domain knowledge in Capital Markets, Trade Surveillance, Anti\-Money Laundering, or Data Analytics tools.
* Familiarity with AI product lifecycle, including model validation, user feedback loops, and ethical implications.
* Exposure to tools like OpenAI, Hugging Face, or Azure ML from a product integration perspective.
* Demonstrated leadership in innovation initiatives, such as generative AI prototypes, automation pilots, or internal product accelerators.
* Familiarity with event\-driven architecture and microservices in SaaS ecosystems.
* Experience using product analytics tools (e.g., Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4\) for KPI tracking and iteration planning.
* Knowledge of privacy and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2\) and their implications on product decisions.
* Familiarity with BDD practices, including Gherkin\-style acceptance criteria.
* Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps environments and their influence on delivery pipelines.
* Comfortable managing vendor integrations, particularly in regulated domains.
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or equivalent certification is a plus.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Backlog Ownership: Manage the product backlog for one or more functional areas, ensuring prioritization aligns with strategic goals.
* Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with stakeholders across business units to define and document both functional and non\-functional requirements.
* User Story Development: Translate requirements into detailed user stories with clear, testable acceptance criteria suitable for 2\-week sprint delivery.
* Design Validation: Work closely with the Design team to ensure stories meet user expectations and support intuitive user experiences.
* Technical Collaboration: Participate in grooming sessions and support task breakdowns and estimations with engineering.
* Solution Prototyping: Contribute to the ideation and prototyping of new features and enhancements.
* Release Communication: Own the creation of release notes and other external documentation for customer\-facing product updates.
* Cross\-Functional Liaison: Serve as the primary interface between Product Management, Engineering, and Design to drive alignment and execution.

jobs.description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting\-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.
 


  


 By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real\-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy.  We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.
 


  






  




**Role Overview:** 
  


 PDI Technologies is looking for a Product Owner to help manage multiple simultaneous projects and issues of varying size, end to end, within our Loyalty engine ecosystem. The Product Owner (PO) is a critical member of an Agile development team that drives the team to deliver high\-quality, high\-value features and functions in service of our Loyalty business.
 


  


 As a PO, you will help shape product features and requirements while working closely with Agile engineering teams, Product Managers, customers, and business stakeholders to build high\-quality products for our target markets. Prior experience in Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analyst roles — ideally with exposure to loyalty, rewards, or CRM (Customer Relationship Management) platforms — is highly desired.
 


  


 This role is expected to use AI tools and processes as a core part of how work gets done — accelerating requirements\-gathering, documentation, and story breakdown so the team can move faster without sacrificing quality.
 


  


  




**Key Responsibilities:** 
  

  
* **Stay aligned with and contribute to** 
 the Loyalty product vision, roadmap, and priorities
  
* Work closely with Support to understand and prioritize customer\-reported issues within the Loyalty ecosystem
  
* Work closely with system users (customers, partners, consulting) to understand business needs and translate them into actionable user stories
  
* Apply technical astuteness, attention to detail, and proactivity to drive closure and optimize development team throughput
  
* Use AI\-assisted tools and workflows to speed up requirements analysis, documentation, and backlog preparation
  
* Serve as a product evangelist, particularly with Product Managers and Business teams, helping them understand platform best practices
  
* Develop documentation for new Loyalty features, including UI mockups, process flows, and data sequence diagrams
  
* Attend sprint planning meetings and work with the team to define sprint goals
  
* Guide Agile teams in breaking down user stories and defining acceptance criteria
  
* Ensure the product backlog is prioritized and properly balanced between new product work and maintenance
  
* Collaborate with engineering during sprints to review output and answer questions about desired functionality and outcomes

* Conduct backlog refinement meetings, sprint reviews, and product demos

* Own release planning for Loyalty initiatives

* Ability to connect technical system behavior (rules engines, transaction/redemption flows, integrations) with business goals for the Loyalty program
  
* Comfort working within a complex, rules\-driven engine where changes can have wide\-reaching downstream effects
  
* Experience with loyalty, rewards, promotions, or CRM platforms is a strong plus

* 2–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Manager, Product Owner, or similar role, including at least 2 years working as an Agile Product Owner
  
* Highly motivated self\-starter with a desire to help others, take action, and seek out resources to excel within the role
  
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into non\-technical terms and vice versa

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
**About StarRez**
 StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off\-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400\+ clients across 25\+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user\-friendly, all\-in\-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Product Owner, you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of product workstreams, acting as the bridge between Product Managers and the development teams. While the Product Manager focuses more on leading the relevant product vision and strategy and generating impactful roadmaps, your role will be to ensure flawless execution of that body of work in conjunction with your Product Engineering team. That includes owning requirements and Acceptance Criteria, grooming the backlog and helping deliver quality software to market.
   

  

 Additionally, you will own and lead well defined projects, as agreed with the Product Manager, to deliver incremental value toward the Product and Technology department's goals. Ultimately, the Product Manager and the Product Owner collaborate to deliver world class outcomes for our business.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
**Backlog Management \& Prioritization**
* Own and manage the product backlog for your assigned product or workstream.
* Collaborate with the Product Manager to understand product goals and ensure backlog prioritization aligns with strategic objectives.
* Clearly define user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements in collaboration with the engineering and design teams.


**Delivery Execution**
* Maintain alignment with the product roadmap, ensuring backlog items are prioritized and executed in line with roadmap goals.
* Identify and independently own well defined initiatives, as agreed with the Product Manager, ensuring successful delivery of these workstreams.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Coordinate with Product Managers to gather business requirements and translate them into actionable tasks.
* Collaborate closely with the Product Manager to ensure all executed work aligns with the product vision and strategic outcomes for the area.
* Actively engage with cross\-functional teams, including Engineering, Design, Quality, and Customer Success.


**Refinement \& Continuous Improvement**
* Assist backlog refinement sessions, sprint planning, and retrospectives, continuously improving processes and team effectiveness.
* Support all relevant agile processes that the team follows, ensuring high levels of collaboration and accountability.
* Analyze and incorporate feedback from users, Quality, and internal stakeholders to refine features and improve outcomes.


**Product Quality \& Value Delivery**
* Collaborate to ensure the delivered product increments meet quality standards and deliver value to users.
* Track and report on key delivery metrics, identifying areas for improvement and ensuring alignment with product goals.
* Ensure proper documentation of delivered features and support the go\-to market process in collaboration with Product Managers.
* Work with the Product Manager to determine optimizations to live features and incremental work that may further enhance the delivery of outcomes.


**Required Qualification**
* 3\+ years of experience as a Product Owner, or similar role in a SaaS environment.
* Strong understanding of agile product development frameworks, including Scrum or Kanban.
* Proven track record of managing complex product backlogs and delivering high impact features on time.
* Excellent collaboration skills with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, design, and QA.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey requirements and priorities to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Analytical mindset, with the ability to break down complex problems into actionable solutions.
* Experience working closely with Product Managers to translate strategic goals into deliverable tasks.
* Familiarity with product management and development tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Miro etc)


**Preferred Qualification**
* Experience working in B2B SaaS, particularly in Property Tech or Housing.
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar agile certification.
* Understanding of user\-centered design principles and product discovery techniques.


**Reasons to Join Our Team**
 StarRez is not just a workplace—it's a place to belong, build, and grow.
   

  

* A Culture That Lasts: Many of our team members have been with us for 20\+ years—a testament to our people\-first philosophy.
* Global Impact, Local Ownership: Join a team that spans across Australia, the USA, the UK, and Canada, working on industry\-leading solutions, while building the centre up from ground up.
* Long\-Term Vision: We're not here for short\-term gains. We invest in our people for the long haul, creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and thrive.
* Innovation with Stability: Backed by Vista Equity Partners, we combine the agility of a scaling SaaS company with the stability of long\-term industry leadership.
* Z\-Factor: We take pride in our culture of passion, care, and high performance. The Z\-Factor defines how we support our teams, foster growth, and ensure that everyone at StarRez thrives.


 StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: FBS Product Owner III- Guidewire
jobs.description:
Takes a fully independent lead in several areas of product development by following the principles of Agile to manage the team backlog, anticipate and prioritize needs, oversee development stages, act as a primary liaison and evaluate product progress. Serves as the customer proxy; works collaboratively with business owners and other stakeholders to accomplish these tasks with little to no support with a high volume of work and increased complexity. Utilizes strong understanding of the business vision to to regularly contribute and manage execution. Heavily influences the business owner's requirements, the Product Manager's program vision and roadmap while introducing new and useful tools and practices to drive continuous improvement. Provides overall leadership to Product Owner team through mentorship and guidance and provides back up to Product Manager, as needed.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Applies basic scientific practice within iterations in order to routinely plan, do, check and adjust. Manages team backlog items and prioritizes based on business value. Outlines dependencies and informs stakeholders the necessary sequence of development to ensure optimized performance and outcomes. Holds a significant role in quality control and is the primary team member empowered to accept stories as done. Utilizes advanced business knowledge, based on prior experience within business function, and communication skills to anticipate problems and address them accordingly. Works cross functionally in a self\-organizing manner to accomplish tasks and effectively manage the backlog. Leads processes and procedure changes identified by teams by working with external business partners. Effectively applies critical thinking to identify flexibility in determining how and when each iteration and product element will be developed. Acts as primary communicator and connection between stakeholders, end users and teams determining if each story meets their shared e xpectations. Ensures collaboration from all stakeholders on decisions and strategy providing clear instructions and deliverables for developers. jobs.description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.


### **The Enterprise Technology Team**


The Enterprise Technology team builds and delivers the secure, scalable systems that power how our business runs. Our People Technology Team sits at the heart of this work, overseeing the full Hire\-to\-Retire technical ecosystem—including core applications like Workday, Greenhouse, and Cornerstone—and ensuring these platforms evolve alongside the company's growth. We partner closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and Business Operations to bring data\-driven, compliant, and innovative solutions to life.


### **The Opportunity**


Reporting to the Director of People Technology, this role will serve as the Product Manager for Okta's People Technology portfolio, focused on Employee Growth \& Talent. You will act as the strategic bridge between global People leaders and delivery teams. You will translate strategic product visions into high\-velocity execution — shaping the what and why in partnership with Digital Solutions and People leadership, and partnering with the Delivery Lead on the how and when — while navigating complex enterprise workflows across Talent Acquisition (Greenhouse), Learning \& Development (Cornerstone), Talent Management (Workday), and AI\-driven automation.


### **What You'll Do**


* **Product Strategy \& Roadmap Leadership:** Define the multi\-year product vision and strategy for the Growth \& Talent domain in close collaboration with functional and technical leadership. Translate that strategy into a prioritized, outcome\-driven roadmap that articulates clear business value, return on investment (ROI), and measurable impact on talent operations and employee experience.
* **Talent Ecosystem Modernization:** Build data\-driven business cases and functional strategies for major platform initiatives across the talent ecosystem (e.g., ATS, LMS, and custom Workday Extend applications), articulating clear ROI, operational efficiency gains, and improved employee and candidate experiences.
* **Delivery Lead Partnership:** Partner closely with the Growth \& Talent Delivery Lead to translate business priorities and functional requirements into well\-scoped epics and user stories, while maintaining clear alignment on trade\-offs, velocity, and delivery milestones.
* **Functional \& Technical Alignment:** Act as the voice of the business and end users within technical discussions, translating complex functional requirements into clear product specifications and acceptance criteria. Partner with the delivery team to evaluate technical trade\-offs, balancing user experience, operational risk, and long\-term scalability.
* **AI \& Talent Automation Strategy:** Define the strategy and functional requirements for integrating AI across the talent lifecycle (sourcing, onboarding, learning, internal mobility)—evaluating build vs. buy solutions, designing human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, and ensuring enterprise\-grade privacy and ethical AI standards.
* **Global Stakeholder Management:** Drive cross\-functional alignment across Digital Solutions, distributed executive stakeholders, business functional leads, and US\-based product counterparts to ensure clear visibility, smooth change management, and high program adoption.

### **What You Bring to Okta**


* 8\+ years of Product Management experience leading internal enterprise platforms, enterprise HR/Talent systems, or complex B2B SaaS products at global scale.
* **Deep Talent Tech Domain Expertise:** In\-depth understanding of core Talent Acquisition, Learning \& Development, and Performance/Talent Management processes, with hands\-on familiarity with enterprise platforms such as Greenhouse, Cornerstone, and Workday Talent (or equivalent ATS/LMS/HCM ecosystems).
* **Strategic Business Case \& ROI Sizing:** Proven ability to translate long\-term business goals into multi\-year product strategies, build data\-backed investment cases, and measure the tangible ROI and operational impact of platform initiatives.
* **Technical Fluency \& Cross\-Functional Translation:** Demonstrated track record partnering with delivery teams on system integrations, data flows, and technical trade\-offs—translating complex business requirements into clear functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and PRDs.
* **AI \& Automation Acumen:** Functional understanding of enterprise AI applications, generative AI capabilities, and automated workflows, with an appreciation for human\-in\-the\-loop design, ethical AI, and data privacy safeguards.
* **Autonomous Global Leadership:** Proven success operating with high autonomy across distributed time zones (US / APAC / EMEA), driving alignment and influencing senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams asynchronously.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent practical experience.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience scoping and delivering solutions on enterprise platform extensibility frameworks (e.g., Workday Extend, orchestration engines, or custom application ecosystems).
* Direct experience conceptualizing, testing, or deploying agentic AI workflows, conversational interfaces, or autonomous task automation in an enterprise HR context.
* Working knowledge of enterprise data governance, compliance standards (SOX, SOC2, GDPR), and sensitive employee data handling.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Product Manager, Networking and Switches
jobs.description:
Senior Technical Product Manager, Networking and Switches


Reports To: VP of Products  

Location: Plano, TX, Lawrence, PA, or India (preferred for direct access to our hardware labs), or Remote (US).  

Travel: 20%


What You Will Do

* Technical Portfolio Strategy and Optimization: Evaluate the existing networking, converter, and console server portfolio to drive SKU rationalization, BOM optimization, and margin improvement. Identify which products to consolidate or sunset and which high\-margin lines to scale.
* OEM/ODM Vendor Architecture and Management: Act as the primary technical interface with our global manufacturing partners. Influence their roadmaps, negotiate technical SLAs, and drive root\-cause analysis and supplier quality corrections for field failures.
* Rigorous Product Engineering and QA Leadership: Own the firmware and hardware validation gate. Design and execute New Product Introduction testing, regulatory compliance verification, and automated test frameworks.
* Level 3 Escalation Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for complex field failures. Perform hands\-on debugging in the lab, translate field data into engineering requirements, and enforce corrective actions with vendors.
* Engineering Impact of Compliance and Certification: Partner with the Compliance Manager, who tracks market mandates and certification requirements. You translate those mandates into hardware and firmware requirements, evaluating vendor BOMs and architectures so that component or firmware changes do not silently invalidate FIPS, TAA, UL, NERC CIP, and other relevant standards.
* Lifecycle and Knowledge Execution: Manage the product lifecycle from NPI through End\-of\-Life. Build the technical documentation, training material, troubleshooting guides, firmware test checklists, and compatibility matrices that empower support, Product Ops, and adjacent product managers.
* Cross\-Portfolio Technical Collaboration: Act as the networking subject matter expert for the broader product organization, supporting Sales and Product Marketing with technical content.


Core Technical Expertise

* Layer 2 and Layer 3 Networking Standards: VLANs (802\.1Q), Spanning Tree Protocols (STP/RSTP/MSTP), link aggregation (LACP), QoS/CoS prioritization, IP routing (Static, OSPF), IGMP snooping, and security mechanisms like 802\.1X and ACLs.
* Media Conversion and Physical Layer Mechanics: Optical and copper interfaces (SFP/SFP\+, RJ\-45, single\-mode vs. multi\-mode fiber, wavelength specifications), Power over Ethernet standards, and rate\-matching mechanics.
* PoE System Engineering: PSE/PD classification and power budget validation across 802\.3af, 802\.3at, intelligent detection and backward\-compatibility behavior, and downstream device power profiling.
* Harsh\-Environment and Industrial Specifications: Industrial hardening, wide operating temperatures, high EMC/EMI immunity, redundant power inputs, ring redundancy protocols, and DIN\-rail or panel\-mount deployment.
* Out\-of\-Band Management and Connectivity Protocols: Console server architectures, secure out\-of\-band access, terminal emulation, serial\-over\-IP encapsulation, and USB extension technology.
* Security, Authentication, and Compliance Implementation: How standards are physically and logically implemented in networking gear, including TPM 2\.0, FIPS 140\-2/3 validated cryptographic modules, TAA\-compliant supply chains, and NERC CIP supporting features; AAA frameworks (TACACS\+, RADIUS, Kerberos, 802\.1X) and VPN technologies (OpenVPN, IPsec) as applied to secure out\-of\-band platforms; plus ZTP, RESTful API, and SNMP/LLDP/NTP integration.
* Serial and Signal Extension Technologies: Classic serial interfaces (RS\-232, RS\-422, RS\-485\) and V.35/Coax signal conversion, along with the electrical principles of signal attenuation, impedance matching, and long\-distance copper extension.
* OT and Industrial Serial Practice: Modbus ASCII/RTU over RS\-422/485, and serial line conditioning including bias, termination, isolation (e.g., 2\-kV), and surge protection.


Who Will Succeed in This Role

* You are a hands\-on technical leader who is just as comfortable reading a market trend report as you are hooking up a serial cable to debug a spanning\-tree loop in the lab.
* You have experience managing OEM/ODM relationships and know how to hold external engineering teams accountable to strict quality and firmware standards.
* You understand that in an extensive hardware portfolio, strategy is realized through rigorous execution, BOM optimization, and reliable technical sustainment
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related technical field; OR equivalent hands\-on experience with a proven track record in hardware validation and network engineering.
* Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network\+, or equivalent industrial networking certifications are highly preferred and can substitute for formal education requirements.


EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related technical field; OR equivalent hands\-on experience with a proven track record in hardware validation and network engineering.
* Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network\+, or equivalent industrial networking certifications are highly preferred and can substitute for formal education requirements.

**About the job** 
 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
   

  

 In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
   

  

 One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
   

  

 The 3M team (Migrate, Manage, Modernize) is redefining enterprise cloud adoption. Our team leads Google Cloud’s migration and modernization products, shifting the industry from legacy lift\-and\-shift approaches to AI\-motivated, agentic transformation of customer workloads. By leveraging generative Artificial Intelligence (AI), we build intelligent systems that assess, modernize, and deploy enterprise workloads from on\-premises or other clouds directly to modern, cloud\-native architectures.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead zero\-to\-one AI product initiatives, directly shaping how global enterprises adopt Google Cloud. You will be taking ownership of pioneering technology, high organizational visibility, and the opportunity to work at the intersection of AI and cloud infrastructure.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own and execute complex product requirements for our migration platform, designing the end\-to\-end customer journey for rapid automated discovery, assessment, billing and cost analysis ingestion, and AI\-powered quick Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) estimators to reduce enterprise proposal timelines from months to days.

jobs.description:
About Bytebeam
 
 Bytebeam builds the hardware and software that power the next generation of smart connected vehicles. We do device telemetry, remote diagnostics, OTA updates, alerts, and fleet\-scale device management. We help teams ship connected products faster and run them reliably in the field. We are now building an AI\-native platform for Indian commercial fleets. We are building it to be several times better than anything in the market, not a little better.
 


 Role Overview
 
 We are hiring a Product Manager to own products end to end and grow the platform into new categories and new geographies. You are the first point of contact for an idea: you turn it into a sharp product, ship it, and prove it moved the user's outcome.
 



 This is a hands\-on, AI\-first role, and your edge is discovery. In the AI era building is cheap, so finding the right problem is the job. You live in the field, find the real problem, and own it until it is solved and measured, working with engineering, design, data, sales, and support to get there.
 


 What you'll do
 * Own products end to end: Shape a rough idea into a sharp PRD, prioritize hard, ship it, and measure the outcome. Always separate the real need from what people ask for.
* Live in the field: Sit with fleet owners, drivers, and operators where they work, run a customer advisory board, and find the real problem, not the surface one.
* Grow into new markets: Take the product into new customer categories and new geographies, and go get the operators no one serves well today.
* Aim for the multiple: Study the competition, know where we are ahead and behind, and push every feature to be 5x\-10x better, not a little better.
* Set the metric and the guardrail: Give every feature a success metric that proves the promise, and a guardrail for what breaks if it works too well.
* Work AI\-first: Use AI across the whole job (discovery, research, prototyping, PRDs, analysis) to move fast and go deep. Push it hard.


 What we're looking for
 * 3\+ years in product management, ideally B2B software, fleet, logistics, IoT, telematics, automotive, or operations\-heavy products.
* You have owned a product end to end and moved a real metric, from discovery through launch to adoption and revenue.
* You are excellent at discovery: you find the real problem, tell a need from a want and a root cause from a symptom, and move on the best truth available instead of waiting for perfect data.
* High ownership: You do whatever it takes to reach the outcome, vendor and supplier coordination included, and "that's not my job" is not in your vocabulary.
* AI\-first: You already use AI tools every day and push them hard. You don't shy away from learning new methods and tools to leverage AI better.
* A people person who gets the unsaid truth out of a fleet owner, and willing to travel and sit in hard places. If a problem lives in a mine, that is where you will be.


 Why Bytebeam
 * Real products, used in production by teams running connected vehicles and fleets.
* High ownership in a small team: fewer layers, faster decisions, and close contact with customers. You own your product and run it.
* Work that spans software, hardware, field operations, fleet economics, and reliability.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise\-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet\-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Part Of**
 Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
   

  

 What you'll be responsible for
   

  

 You will own product areas within Managed Payments, Circle’s regulated payments infrastructure that enables PSPs, financial institutions, banks, and enterprises to use stablecoin\-powered payment rails without operating crypto infrastructure themselves. You will define and evolve product capabilities that support managed pay\-ins, payouts, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management across stablecoin and fiat endpoints. Working closely with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Treasury, and commercial teams, you will translate complex customer and business needs into clear product priorities, lead cross\-functional execution, and deliver measurable improvements to how customers move money across geographies and payment rails.
   

  

 What you'll work on
   

  

* Own the roadmap for product areas across managed pay\-ins, payouts, fiat endpoints, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management, aligning priorities with customer needs and Circle’s goals.
* Define and launch capabilities that expand Managed Payments across Circle’s regulated hubs, including new entities, corridors, payout methods, and geographic coverage.
* Shape simple, reliable customer experiences for accepting funds, converting value, and disbursing globally across stablecoin and fiat rails, including integrations with CPN and other Circle systems.
* Improve customer and operator workflows across onboarding, account setup, transaction visibility, reporting, exception handling, reconciliation, refunds, RFIs, and bulk payments.
* Use customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify friction, prioritize investments, and measure improvements in reliability, efficiency, adoption, and customer experience.
* Evaluate opportunities to support new payment rails, payout use cases, and digital assets based on customer demand, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, and business priorities.
* Lead complex cross\-functional initiatives with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, BD, and Product, navigating technical and business trade\-offs and driving alignment from definition through launch.


 What you'll bring to Circle
   

  

 Core requirements
   

  

* 4\+ years of relevant experience, including product management experience building payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, or similarly complex B2B products.
* Experience owning product vision, roadmaps, and execution for B2B capabilities such as payments, pay\-ins, payouts, settlement, treasury infrastructure, APIs, or financial operations.
* Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex cross\-functional initiatives spanning Engineering and partners such as Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, or commercial teams.
* Strong analytical and technical fluency, with experience using customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify opportunities and guide product decisions.
* Track record of delivering measurable improvements to customer experience, product adoption, operational efficiency, reliability, or business performance.
* Ability to evaluate technical and business trade\-offs, resolve ambiguity, and translate complex requirements into clear product priorities and execution plans.


**Preferred Requirements**
* Knowledge of cross\-border payments, PSP infrastructure, settlement systems, correspondent banking, or other payment network concepts.
* Familiarity with stablecoins, blockchain\-based financial infrastructure, or crypto\-enabled payment systems.
* Experience with enterprise APIs, payment networks, or compliance\-forward systems involving payment lifecycle states, reconciliation, exception handling, sanctions screening, RFIs, or SLAs.


 Why this role matters
   

  

 Managed Payments is a core part of Circle’s strategy to make stablecoin\-powered payments accessible to businesses beyond crypto\-native customers. Customers increasingly need complete payment programs that allow them to accept funds, manage balances, convert across assets, and disburse globally without assembling wallets, banking partners, liquidity providers, compliance systems, and payout networks themselves. As Senior Product Manager, you will help turn that complexity into an integrated customer experience and scale Managed Payments into a reliable, global, enterprise\-grade product.

**Job Summary:**
 As a Genesys Product Owner, you will lead the product vision, roadmap and backlog for our global contact center platform, with a strong focus on Genesys Cloud capabilities, Universal UI, AI capabilities and business value realization. You will work closely with customer service stakeholders, architects, business analysts, developers and operations teams to define, prioritize and deliver scalable omnichannel solutions that enhance customer experience, improve agent productivity and support global standardization across Siemens Healthineers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Own and manage the product backlog for Genesys Cloud and related contact center capabilities, ensuring alignment with business priorities, customer needs and global transformation objectives.
* Define product vision, roadmap and release priorities for contact center features including routing, IVR, digital channels, reporting, workforce optimization and integrations.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, regional teams and technical experts to gather requirements, refine user stories and translate strategic goals into actionable delivery plans.
* Prioritize demand, change requests and technical enablers based on business value, operational impact, compliance needs and platform scalability.
* Partner with architects and engineering teams to ensure solution design decisions are feasible, supportable and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning and acceptance activities, and provide timely decisions to unblock delivery teams.
* Track product performance, adoption and operational outcomes using KPIs, analytics and stakeholder feedback, and continuously improving the platform roadmap.
* Support go\-live planning, rollout readiness, change communication and post\-production stabilization for new Genesys capabilities and enhancements.


**Required Skills and Experience:**
* Strong experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or similar role in contact center transformation, customer service technology or digital product delivery.

* Strong understanding of agile delivery practices, backlog management, user story writing, acceptance criteria and prioritization techniques.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to align business, operations and technical teams across regions and time zones.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to assess business value, operational trade\-offs, risks and dependencies in a complex enterprise environment.
* Experience with tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira or similar platforms for backlog management, release planning and delivery tracking.
* Customer\-centric mindset with a strong focus on service experience, process simplification, adoption and measurable business outcomes.

* Experience working with cross\-functional teams spanning business, architecture, development, testing and operations.
* Knowledge of integration with adjacent enterprise platforms such as CRM, reporting, workforce management or automation tools is an advantage.
* Experience working in global programs with distributed teams and stakeholders across multiple countries and time zones.

**Product Owner Data and Integrations**
**Location: Bangalore**
**Overview:** 
 Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced and business\-focused Product Owner to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of data and integrations teams for an enterprise eCommerce application. This role will serve as the bridge between business stakeholders, technology teams, data engineering, architecture, and external partners to translate business needs into scalable data flows, APIs, integration requirements, and prioritized product backlogs. The Product Owner will drive outcomes that improve data quality, system interoperability, operational efficiency, and user adoption while ensuring solutions meet security, governance, performance, and compliance expectations. The role requires techno\-functional skills to analyze data, write SQLs, create and update field mappings, and debug issues with cross\-platform teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own and maintain the product vision, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for data and integrations teams.
* Be the SME for APIs, and data process flows.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand objectives, pain points, reporting needs, process gaps, and integration requirements, translating them into clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with data engineering, application development, architecture, security, and QA teams to design and deliver scalable, reliable, and secure data and integration solutions.
* Ensure data quality, lineage, governance, privacy, and compliance considerations are embedded into product requirements and delivery decisions.
* Manage sprint planning, backlog refinement, release planning, demos, and stakeholder reviews in alignment with Agile delivery practices.
* Evaluate technical feasibility, business value, risk, and dependency impacts when prioritizing features, enhancements, defects, and technical debt.
* Work with teams to establish performance, reliability, monitoring, and support expectations for data pipelines, APIs, and integration services.
* Support user acceptance testing by validating that delivered capabilities meet business objectives, functional requirements, and defined acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate cross\-functional dependencies across internal teams, external vendors, and enterprise platforms to ensure successful end\-to\-end delivery.
* Communicate product status, roadmap priorities, delivery risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
* Drive adoption and continuous improvement by gathering feedback, monitoring usage, measuring product success, and identifying opportunities to enhance data and integration capabilities.


**Qualifications**
* 6\-8 years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, solution delivery, data platforms, integrations, or enterprise application delivery.
* Demonstrated experience defining product roadmaps, managing backlogs, writing user stories, and prioritizing work based on business value, technical feasibility, and stakeholder impact.
* Functional understanding of APIs and data integration concepts, including APIs, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, batch and real\-time processing, data mapping, and system interoperability.
* Experience working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ERP, CRM, data warehouses, data lakes, middleware, iPaaS, or integration platforms.
* Ability to translate complex business processes and data needs into clear functional and technical requirements for engineering and delivery teams.
* Familiarity with data governance, data quality, data privacy, master data management, lineage, security, and compliance considerations.
* Experience working in Agile Scrum teams, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with business users, technical teams, vendors, architects, QA teams, and leadership.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain data and integration concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Analytical mindset with strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to balance strategic product direction with day\-to\-day delivery decisions.
* Experience with product management and delivery tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of cloud data platforms, API management, event streaming, middleware, or modern integration architecture is preferred.
* Relevant certifications such as Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, Salesforce, cloud, data, or integration certifications are preferred.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are building a next\-generation enterprise SaaS platform designed to streamline complex operational workflows across HR, labor management, payroll, revenue management, purchasing, and accounting. We are looking for a Business Analyst who can sit at the intersection of product strategy and engineering execution — someone who turns business intent into sprint\-ready work that a development team can build without ambiguity.

This is a hands\-on, delivery\-focused role. You will work directly with the Product Owner and Technical Lead, own the product backlog, and be the daily bridge between business stakeholders and the engineering team.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**Requirements \& Backlog**

* Work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to understand business needs, define requirements, and translate them into actionable backlog items
* Maintain and prioritize the product backlog — always keep N\+3 sprints of refined, ready items ahead of the development team so sprints never start cold
* Prepare additional backlog items proactively based on business needs, dependencies, gaps, and upcoming functionality

**User Stories \& Acceptance Criteria**

* Break down high\-level requirements and epics into precise, buildable user stories
* Write clear acceptance criteria — your stories are the contract between product and engineering, and developers ship without re\-clarification
* Identify dependencies, edge cases, and integration points before stories reach sprint planning

**Agile Ceremonies**

* Conduct backlog refinement sessions with Product Owners, developers, and QA teams
* Participate actively in sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives
* Facilitate productive, time\-boxed refinement sessions — you keep the conversation focused and the output actionable

**Process Analysis**

* Analyse existing business workflows and identify opportunities to eliminate manual work, reduce errors, and improve efficiency through the platform
* Document current\-state and future\-state process flows to guide development priorities

**Quality \& Validation**

* Support and validate UAT — you own confirming that what was built matches what was asked for
* Collaborate with QA to ensure test cases align with acceptance criteria
* Participate in defect triage and help distinguish product gaps from scope creep

**WHAT YOU MUST BRING**

* 4–8 years as a Business Analyst on software product delivery — not consulting or documentation only, but actual end\-to\-end sprint delivery
* Proven experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria that development teams ship without constant clarification
* Comfort in Agile/Scrum environments — you know the difference between a story, an epic, and a spike, and you can run a refinement session
* Hands\-on experience with JIRA and Confluence; familiarity with Azure DevOps
* Strong communication skills — you translate between non\-technical stakeholders and engineers fluently, in both directions
* Ability to manage competing priorities and keep multiple sprint queues healthy simultaneously

**WHAT WILL SET YOU APART**

* Experience on multi\-tenant SaaS platforms — you understand how shared infrastructure affects product decisions
* Prior work on ERP, HRMS, payroll, or financial software
* Familiarity with Figma — you can review UI designs for completeness before development begins
* Experience working with offshore or distributed development teams
* Exposure to API\-driven integrations and an understanding of how third\-party systems connect

**DETAILS**

* **Location: Bangalore, India — on\-site**
* **Experience: 4–8 years**
* **Employment: Full time**

Pay: ₹75,000\.00 \- ₹150,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
